_what_this_is: Deliberate defects injected into REAL VOX source, one at a time, in place
(backed up byte-for-byte and restored — see run.py). Each must make the gate
go red. One that escapes is a class of bug that can currently merge with
THIS FILE IS PROTECTED (FACTORY_RULES §5, harness/**). A builder that can
edit its own defect set can pass it.
Every defect below is seeded from the R2.5a escaped-bug corpus — bugs that
actually got past VOX's visible checks — re-expressed as one-line mutations.
`catch` names the rung families expected to notice; the runner tries those
first and escalates to the full ladder before declaring an escape. At least
one defect aims at each rung, including above the independence line: a set
caught entirely by 'unit' proves only that the unit suite can fail.

defects.why: the kV guard is the proof case of the whole fidelity family; if a blinded detector still reports green, the guard's own discrimination (planted drifts MUST be caught) is not real and 13.2 kV can silently become 13.2 KV in a dispute-ready record

the June-11 report bug verbatim: on high-volume days the dedup pass collapsed Schedule (§10) and Communications (§12) to 'See §X' stubs; if unprotecting them escapes, the busiest days lose their two forward-looking sections again

Bucket-1 item 1.2 verbatim: counting failed recipients as delivered marks an undelivered report 'distributed' — the app says Sent for contract documentation nobody received. Aimed at the holdout on purpose: the above-the-line rung must be shown able to fail

the 1.6a device-wipe trap: with the identity guard blinded, an anon-key fallback read of entitlements returns empty-with-200 and the client treats it as authoritative revocation — destruction authorized by an unauthenticated read
the query path's whole claim is a sourced answer; if dropping every citation frame escapes, answers stream uncited and nothing below the E2E asserts the citation chain at all

the honest-abstention contract: with the 0-row branch disabled, an unanswerable question goes to the model anyway and the system invents an answer instead of saying it has nothing — the exact failure the measured 0.35 floor exists to prevent

empty-is-not-pass wearing pipeline clothes: the claim never matches, the stage returns 200 'Already processing', and the run stalls at cleaned forever while every call reports success — only a journey that asserts each observable stage notices

an output made constant (empty): the report row says pdf_generated with a pdf_url, every status check passes, and the artifact a stakeholder would open is zero bytes — only downloading the actual PDF catches it
